full_judgment: 2. Short facts necessary for the disposal of the Rule are: Opposite party Abdus Sattar as plaintiff instituted a suit in the Court of the Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar Dinajpur, being Other Class Suit No.325 of 1986, praying for a declaration that the ex parte decree dated 7-6-83 obtained by the defendant in Other Class Suit No.61 of 1983 of the 1st Court of Munsif, Dinajpur is collusive, fraudulent, inoperative and not binding upon him alleging, inter alia, that the suit land measuring 21 decimals in CS Plot No. 923 under CS Khatian No.28 of mouza Balupari, PS Kotwali, District Dinajpur belonged to Bibi Kaniz Fatema and her son Chowdhury Shafi Ahmed and it was a fallow land; as a shelterless man he was in search of an accommodation in Dinajpur town and occupied 5 decimals of land from the aforesaid plot by its southern side in Chaitra, 1374 BS and after constructing thatch huts thereon he has been living there peacefully and uninterruptedly for over 20 , years within the full view and knowledge of its owners, the defendant and all others in assertion of hostile title, denying the title of the owners and in this way he has acquired a good title in the said land by way of adverse possession; recently he learnt that 8 decimals of land by the north-western side of plot No. 923 has become a khas land of the Government following which he duly applied for lease of the said land to the appropriate authority but the said matter still remains undisposed due to the opposition of the defendant's husband, who happens to be a mohorar of an Advocate; it recently transpired that by filing a collusive suit on false and frivolous allegations in Other Class Suit No.61 of 1983 in the 1st Court of Munsif, Sadar Dinajpur, against Chowdhury Shafi Ahmed' falsely alleging that on 13-2.71 the timer had contracted to sell 24 decimals of land of suit plot No.923, including the 5 decimals of land in possession of the plaintiff, and by fraudulent suppression of all legal processes the defendant was able to obtain a collusive decree therein on 7-6-83; the defendant also purported to have obtained possession through Court on 9-7-86 though, in reality, she did not obtain any physical possession . The aforesaid ex-parte decree dated 7-6-83 in OC Suit No.61/83 obtained by the defendant has clouded his' title in the suit land and that necessitated the filing of the suit.
